title: Executive Decree no.25-149 of 6 Dhou El Hidja 1446 corresponding to 2 June 2025
summary: The above-mentioned Executive Decree aims at approving the renewal of license of establishment and operation of electronic communication network open to the public by satellite GMPCS network and to provide electronic communications services to the public, granted to the company « Algérie Télécom Satellite S.P.A ».
